Un greffier note ce qui s'est passé, apr: A clerk records what happened, after questioning several witnesses. The harbour legends lose a few monsters here.
Chacun n'en voit qu'un côté depuis son b: Each person sees only one side of it from their bench. People meet here to compare points of view before voting.
On y suspend son jugement le temps d'ent: Here you suspend your judgement long enough to hear the opposing argument. Certainties come in by the handful and leave fewer.
Des lignes égales qui paraissent inégale: Equal lines that look unequal, a moon too big on the horizon. Here you learn that seeing is not knowing.
Quand la fièvre frappe, on y affiche les: When fever strikes, the facts are posted here before rumour can name a culprit. Nobody has been driven off the island since.
Quatre statues pour quatre façons de se: Four statues for four ways of being wrong: the tribe, the cave, the marketplace, the theatre. Students greet them as they come in.
Un bulbe s'y est vendu le prix d'une mai: A bulb sold here for the price of a house, then for nothing. The slate stayed on the wall, as a reminder.
Chacun écrit son estimation du poids san: Everyone writes down their estimate of the weight without looking at their neighbour, and the average is spot on. By show of hands, it is another story.
On y recueille les récits tout de suite,: Accounts are collected here straight away, separately, without prompting the answers. The island's memories contradict each other less.
On renforçait là où elles étaient abîmée: They used to reinforce where the boats were damaged. Now they reinforce where the ones that sank must have been.
Pour tester une idée, on y cherche ce qu: To test an idea, you look here for what would bring it down, not what suits it. The island's conspiracies do not survive long here.
Avant d'être affichée en ville, toute st: Before being posted in town, every statistic is checked here. "On average" never gets through without an explanation.
Les étiquettes y disent le prix, pas cel: Labels here show the price, not the one before. Customers leave with what they came for.
Qui affirme sans savoir doit retourner l: Whoever asserts without knowing must turn the hourglass over and find a source before it runs out. Most prefer to sit back down.
Avant chaque examen, on y note ce qu'on: Before every exam, you write down what you think you know, then compare. The most self-assured learn the most here.
Avant chaque grand chantier, on imagine: Before every big project, people imagine it has failed and look for why. The island's bridge owes it its three extra pillars.
Un parcours dans les hautes herbes qui r: A path through the tall grass that recalls what world our heads were made for. You understand your weakness for sugar here.
Elle sonne parfois pour rien, et c'est v: It sometimes rings for nothing, and that is deliberate: better ten false alarms than one missed fire. People learn not to hold it against it.

On y met de côté pour l'hiver ce qu'on a: Here you set aside for winter what you would happily have eaten at once. Every autumn, it is the same battle against yourself.
